description: A Python module for generating DATEV CSV files, including functions to create CSV content, headers, and zip archives for download, specifically tailored for DATEV format and integration with Frappe framework.

methods.name: get_datev_csv
methods.description: Generates a DATEV formatted CSV from input data, applying necessary formatting and sorting based on data category.

methods.name: get_header
methods.description: Creates the header row for the DATEV CSV, including metadata and configuration details.

methods.name: zip_and_download
methods.description: Compresses CSV files into a zip archive and prepares them for download via Frappe response.
